title: dedicated-autoscaler: add per-fleet burst token limits and utilization reporting hooks
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add per-fleet configurable burst token limits to the dedicated autoscaler and surface per-fleet utilization metrics. Backfills historical utilization for dashboards. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: customers running dedicated fleets observed uneven burst consumption which could starve other fleets and cause latency spikes. This PR introduces per-fleet burst token limits (configurable on the Fleet CRD and via control-plane UI) and emits new utilization metrics that enable per-fleet billing/observability and historical analysis. Design: add a token-bucket limiter per fleet that caps burstable token allocation, plumb the limit through the fleet allocator and autoscaler, and emit fleet_level_{used_tokens,max_tokens,burst_consumption_pct} as tags on existing utilization metrics. The limiter uses the existing token-bucket algorithm with an additional max_burst_tokens field. The autoscaler consults the limiter to decide whether to allow speculative burst capacity when scaling up. Backfill: a short migration adds a job to compute historical burst utilization for the last 30 days into the metrics store so dashboards and alerts can be updated. Changes in this PR: - Fleet API: add optional max_burst_tokens and burst_window_seconds (default 300s). - Autoscaler: incorporate per-fleet TokenLimiter when computing burst allocations. - Allocator: don't overcommit burst tokens across fleets; prefer fairness by configured priority. - Metrics: emit fleet_level_used_tokens, fleet_level_max_burst_tokens, fleet_level_burst_pct_with_tags (fleet, region, instance_type). - Backfill job and migration script for historical metrics. Testing & rollout: unit + integration tests included, canary rollout via canary_autoscale_profile, feature flag autoscaler.per_fleet_burst_limits gated by a feature toggle. Checklist: [x] add Fleet API fields, [x] autoscaler enforcement, [x] allocator changes, [x] metrics + backfill, [x] unit and integration tests, [x] docs + control-plane UI PR to follow. Related: ENG-3142 (autoscaler fairness), ENG-3205 (billing metrics), SUP-8792 (support case for a customer incident).
